identity.title: Max Pothier
identity.greeting: Hi, I'm Max Pothier. Developer and creator.

bio: I took one intro CS class and never looked back. Now I'm a software engineer at a B2B SaaS startup, building full-stack products with TypeScript and LLM APIs.
I have a tendency to disappear down rabbit holes. What starts as 'let me just check how this works' often ends several hours later with mass amounts of console.log statements.
I played volleyball at BYU, and CrossFit keeps that competitive itch scratched. When I'm not coding or in the gym, I'm reading. Stripe Press, biographies, anything where business meets technology.
